_comment: Per-role model metadata. Model IDs and providers come from .env (CHEAP_MODEL, CHEAP_PROVIDER, ...). normalized_cost values are experiment weights, NOT money. price_per_mtok_* is the provider's public list price in USD per million tokens for the model named in price_model, and applies to no other model (change all three together when the .env lineup changes). null = no public per-token price; any system that uses that model reports its dollar cost as unknown. Dollars are never mixed into normalized_cost. Prices looked up 2026-11-10. Groq (openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b): https://console.groq.com/docs/models . Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash-lite, paid tier, standard; output price includes thinking tokens): https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing . NVIDIA (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash): no per-token price published; build.nvidia.com serves them under the NVIDIA API Trial Terms of Service (https://build.nvidia.com/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b , https://build.nvidia.com/models).
